# Bundled pitch dependencies

`pitchy-4.1.0/index.js` and its MIT license are from the Pitchy 4.1.0 npm package. `fft.js-4.0.4/fft.js` and
`package.json` are from the fft.js 4.0.4 npm package; its package metadata identifies the author and MIT license.
These match the lab's existing pins. The pitch instrument checks the source hashes before executing them; no npm
installation or network access is required. A Node.js runtime is still required.
